analysis.evidence: כָּל רֶמֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר הוּא חַי means “every moving creature that is alive.” כָּל quantifies the singular רֶמֶשׂ, extending the grant of food to every creature that fits the description.
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular common noun in the construct state, with רֶמֶשׂ as its complement.
